sections.Profile:
The "Horse Shoes" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on December 18, 1951, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Horseshoes, Games
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: George Molentin
